title: Manifesto
summary: Words only: three statements in the brand's voice, each arriving its own way, a turn where one word becomes the name, then what it is and the action, in 18 s.

params.name: statement3
params.default: So we made the tool speak.

params.name: what
params.description: what the brand is, in plain words; empty reads IDENTITY.md

params.name: action
params.description: the one action at the end

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add manifesto --name my-piece
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
Three statements, three entrances: never the same treatment twice. Keep each under eight words.
Uses these moves from the engine: word-rise, track-in, pop-in, scramble, blur-in.

beats.name: Statement 2
beats.what: tracks in while the first blurs out

when: the brand has a point of view to state
there is no product to show yet, only words
